ai-overview.intro: Paste a page URL — the AI scores how citation-worthy it is for Google's AI Overviews + tells you exactly what to change.

bulk-scan.title: Bulk URL scanner
bulk-scan.intro: Paste up to 25 URLs. We run the full health check on each in parallel (audit + Core Web Vitals + security + redirects + images), then surface a sortable table. Optionally save every result as a snapshot so you can compare later.
bulk-scan.saveSnapshots: Save every result as a snapshot (compare before / after later)
bulk-scan.scanning: Scanning {count, plural, one {# URL} other {# URLs}}…
bulk-scan.pendingHint: ~30-60s per URL · 4 in parallel · this can take a few minutes

code-generator.title: SEO code generator (AI-powered)
code-generator.description: Generate WordPress plugins, HTML snippets, Elementor blocks, .htaccess rules, schema markup, Shopify Liquid, Next.js routes — anything an SEO needs to add to a website. AI writes it, you paste it. With install instructions and a preview when possible.
code-generator.taskPlaceholder: Describe in plain English. e.g. 'Add JSON-LD schema for a local restaurant: name, address, phone, opening hours, 4.5 stars from 200 reviews.'
code-generator.constraintsPlaceholder: e.g. WordPress 6.5+, no jQuery, prefix all functions with mybiz_
code-generator.errDescribe: Describe what you want the code to do.
code-generator.errTooLong: Keep the task description under 2000 chars.
code-generator.errNoAi: AI provider didn't respond. Make sure you've configured one in Settings → AI.
code-generator.errEmpty: Got an empty response — try rephrasing the task.

presets.wp-plugin-simple: Add auto-generated meta description to all posts that don't have one yet. Pull the first 155 chars of post content as the fallback.
presets.wp-plugin-advanced: Build a 'Local SEO Schema' plugin with an admin settings page where I can enter business name, address, phone, opening hours, and it injects LocalBusiness JSON-LD on every page.
presets.wp-functions: Add a canonical tag self-referencing every post / page automatically, but allow override via a custom field 'custom_canonical'.
presets.html-snippet: An FAQ accordion (5 questions about my product) with FAQ schema JSON-LD baked in. Pure HTML/CSS, no JS.
presets.elementor-html: Pricing-comparison table for 3 plans (Starter $9, Pro $29, Agency $99) styled clean modern violet. Each plan has 5 features + a CTA button.
presets.shopify-liquid: Add Product schema with reviews + breadcrumb schema to product pages. Use Shopify's product, shop, request objects.
presets.schema-jsonld: Article schema for a blog post titled 'How to Speed Up WordPress' by author Jane Doe published 2026-03-15, with reading time 8 min.
presets.htaccess: Force HTTPS, force www, remove trailing slashes, redirect /old-blog/* to /blog/*. Add HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy headers.
presets.nginx-config: Permanent redirect /products/old-name → /products/new-name. Add security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options). Cache static assets for 1 year.
presets.robots-txt: Allow all search engines on the public site. Block /admin, /api, /cart. Block AI scrapers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Bytespider) from training but allow user-agent AI assistants. Include sitemap.
presets.tracking-js: Track scroll depth (25, 50, 75, 100%) and time-on-page in 30-second buckets. Send to Google Analytics 4 as custom events.
presets.react-component: An SEO-optimized hero section: H1, sub-headline, CTA button, optional secondary CTA. Server component. Tailwind styled. Accept props for title, subtitle, ctaLabel, ctaHref.
presets.nextjs-route: A /pricing route. Server component. Tailwind. 3-tier pricing table with FAQ schema injected via JSON-LD. metadata export with optimized title + description.
presets.drupal-twig: Override node--blog-post.html.twig to inject Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in the head.
presets.ghost-injection: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD (name, address, phone, geo coords) site-wide via the Site Header injection field.
presets.webflow-embed: Newsletter signup form (name + email) styled clean dark theme, with privacy disclaimer below. POST to /api/subscribe.

crux-origin.title: CrUX Origin Summary
crux-origin.description: Google's Core Web Vitals ranking signal uses 28-day origin-level field data — not the URL you tested. A page can pass URL-level CWV and still fail the ranking signal because the origin as a whole is slow. This tool fetches both scopes side-by-side.
crux-origin.gapHint: Positive delta = origin is slower than this URL. If origin is failing while URL passes, fixing this single page won't improve the ranking signal — you need to lift performance across the whole site.
crux-origin.noData: Not enough traffic for this scope. Try a higher-traffic URL or origin-level.

dns-whois.title: DNS + WHOIS / RDAP
dns-whois.description: Resolve A / AAAA / MX / NS / TXT / CAA, plus registrar + expiry via RDAP. Catches missing SPF / DMARC / CAA, near-expiry domains, broken nameserver setups. No API key — uses public RDAP gateway.

geo-swot.title: GEO SWOT
geo-swot.description: LLM-generated Strengths / Weaknesses / Opportunities / Threats for AI-search visibility. Groups your last 30d of AI visibility check results per client and asks the model to reason about competitive position.
geo-swot.cardNeedMore: {count, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}} — need 3+
geo-swot.howBody: Pick a client. The SWOT is generated by the AI provider you have configured in Settings — free Gemini / Groq keys are enough. It uses only the AI visibility check data already in your DB, so no extra data leaves this machine except the aggregated prompt summary. Runs in ~10-20 seconds.
geo-swot.clientDescription: Strengths / Weaknesses / Opportunities / Threats for AI-search visibility. Every claim traces to a deterministic data point (see the audit footer at bottom).
geo-swot.noProviderBody: Add a free Gemini or Groq key in <link>Settings → AI provider keys</link> and refresh this page.
geo-swot.templateFallback: template fallback — no AI provider available
geo-swot.dataBehind: Data behind this SWOT ({count} data points)

person-schema.description: Person JSON-LD is now the top E-E-A-T author signal in 2026 — Google's AI Mode uses it for entity verification. Fill in author/expert details and copy the snippet straight into your '<head>'.
person-schema.profileUrl: Author profile URL on your site
person-schema.bioPlaceholder: 12 years building organic-search programs at series-B SaaS companies. Spoke at MozCon 2024.
person-schema.knowsAboutPlaceholder: technical SEO, content strategy, schema markup
person-schema.socials: Social profile URLs (sameAs) — Twitter / LinkedIn / GitHub / Wikipedia

person-schema.scoreWeak: Bare minimum. Add bio, image, ≥2 sameAs links, and credentials to make this meaningful.
person-schema.bp1: Embed inside the article's Article schema as author.
person-schema.bp2: Use the SAME Person across all articles by the same author.

plagiarism.title: Plagiarism + AI detector
plagiarism.intro: AI-powered review of how AI-generated and how original your content reads. For a definitive verbatim-plagiarism check against the live web, use the linked external tools — they have full web indexes we don't.
plagiarism.placeholder: Paste the article, blog post, or product description you're about to publish…
plagiarism.aiMid: Some AI signals — could be tightened
plagiarism.flagsHint: Common AI templates spotted in your draft. Rewrite these in your own voice.
plagiarism.verifyHint: AI-detection alone misses verbatim plagiarism. Run these for a full check:
plagiarism.errTooShort: Need at least 100 characters for a meaningful read.
plagiarism.errTooLong: Content too long (max 20k chars). Split into sections and check each.
plagiarism.errNoAi: No AI provider responded. Configure an API key in Settings → AI.
plagiarism.errFormat: AI returned an unexpected format. Try again.

ext.originalityNote: Paid, but the most accurate AI + plagiarism combo.
ext.quetextNote: Free up to 500 words for verbatim plagiarism check.
ext.googleNote: Quoted-phrase Google search — instant plagiarism eyeball.

reddit-research.title: Reddit research
reddit-research.intro: Reddit is in 40% of LLM citations. Find the actual questions and pain points your audience asks. No API key — uses Reddit's public JSON endpoint.
reddit-research.subredditPlaceholder: espresso  ·  or leave blank for site-wide
reddit-research.questionsHint: These are post titles phrased as questions — perfect FAQ section material + content brief seeds.
reddit-research.errRateLimit: Reddit rate-limited the request. Wait a few minutes and try again.

redirects-bulk.title: Bulk redirect-chain tester
redirects-bulk.description: Paste up to 100 URLs. We trace every redirect hop, surface chains, loops, mixed-scheme jumps, dropped 301s. Migration-day staple.

findings.loopDetails: The URL redirects back into a cycle, so browsers give up and nobody reaches the page. Traced {hops} hops before stopping.
findings.chainDetails: Each hop costs time and loses a little of what the link passes on. Pointing {url} straight at {finalUrl} removes both.
findings.mixedTitle: {url} redirects through http before reaching https
findings.mixedDetails: The first request travels unencrypted, so anything on the network sees the URL before the redirect to https happens.
findings.deadDetails: After {hops, plural, one {# hop} other {# hops}} the final URL {finalUrl} returns {status}.

reputation-abuse-risk.title: Site reputation abuse risk scan
reputation-abuse-risk.description: Google's site reputation abuse policy (March 2024, expanded Nov 2025) algorithmically flags sections of a site that look 'starkly different' from the main content and stops passing authority to them. We crawl your site, group by path, and flag sections at risk.
reputation-abuse-risk.hint: Crawls up to 30 pages from the homepage's internal links. The scan groups pages by top-level path (e.g. /blog/, /coupons/) and compares each section's topic signature against the rest of the site.
reputation-abuse-risk.breakdownHint: Sorted by risk severity. Sections with low topic overlap and 3+ pages are flagged.
reputation-abuse-risk.sectionMeta: {pages} pages · {overlap}% topic overlap with rest of site
reputation-abuse-risk.fix1: If the section is third-party (affiliate / partner / outsourced content), restore first-party editorial oversight: a named editor on staff who reviews + bylines every page.
reputation-abuse-risk.fix2: If the section is genuinely off-topic for your brand, consider moving it to a subdomain you don't want to inherit authority from — Google treats subdomains as separate entities anyway, so the policy hit is moot there.
reputation-abuse-risk.fix3: If the section was useful but neglected, refresh it with the same brand voice as the rest of the site so the topic signature aligns.
reputation-abuse-risk.fix4: If the section is parasite SEO, take it down. Google's manual actions team is now actively de-indexing these.

robots-history.title: robots.txt history + diff
robots-history.description: Snapshot any host's robots.txt. Each snapshot is hashed; we only store the body when it actually changes. Catches accidental Disallow: / disasters before they hurt indexing.
robots-history.hostMeta: {count, plural, one {# snapshot} other {# snapshots}} · last {date}

serp-features.title: SERP feature tracker
serp-features.description: One tool, three jobs: AI Overview presence + citation tracking, featured snippet hunter, People-Also-Ask question miner. Type a query → we scrape live, store the snapshot, surface opportunities. Free, browser-mode.
serp-features.empty: No snapshots yet. Capture one above.
serp-features.oppHint: You rank #2-5 with a competitor in the snippet. Match their format (40-60 word direct-answer paragraph for paragraph snippets, ordered list for list snippets) and re-publish to take it.
serp-features.paaHint: Every PAA question we've seen across captures, ranked by frequency. Each one is a content idea — answer it in 40-60 words to compete for the snippet.

serp-volatility.title: SERP volatility
serp-volatility.description: Day-over-day position shifts across every tracked keyword. When this score spikes, Google probably rolled an algorithm update — check the algorithm-updates timeline.
serp-volatility.stormy: High volatility — Google likely rolled an update. Pause big content moves.
serp-volatility.calm: Quiet SERP. Good window for testing changes.
serp-volatility.noKeywords: No tracked keywords yet. Add some on /keywords first.
serp-volatility.noMovements: No keywords have ≥2 rank checks in the last {days} days. Run rank checks for a few keywords and come back.
serp-volatility.gainersEmpty: No keywords improved in this window.
serp-volatility.droppersEmpty: No keywords dropped in this window.

sitemap.description: Crawl a site and produce sitemap.xml, a plain-text URL list, and a human-readable HTML index. Same crawler the auditor uses — respects robots.txt by default.

uptime.description: Add URLs we should ping. Each ping records status, latency, expected-text match. Free, self-hosted alternative to UptimeRobot / Pingdom — runs from your server.
uptime.pinged: Pinged {total, plural, one {# target} other {# targets}} — {ok} ok / {failed} failed.

uptime.empty: No targets yet. Add one above.
uptime.targetsHint: 7-day uptime + average latency. Hit "Ping all now" or wire into your scheduler for continuous monitoring.
